# LollipopChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Lollipop chart that renders vertical lines (stems) with circular markers (heads). Now supports multiple series for comparing datasets. Uses the ICanvas interface for rendering, making it backend-agnostic.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new LollipopChart()
new LollipopChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`DefaultHeadRadius`](#defaultheadradius): Default head radius for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`DefaultStemWidth`](#defaultstemwidth): Default stem width for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`LollipopColor`](#lollipopcolor): Color for the lollipop stems and heads (backward compatibility).
